description: Get the native-token balance of an address — raw wei plus a human-readable amount in the chain's native currency. The address may be an ENS name (e.g. 'vitalik.eth').

chain.description: Chain to query. Accepts a slug (eth, base, arb, op, robinhood…), a common name (ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, bsc), or a numeric chain ID (1, 8453). Call list_chains for all valid values.

name: get_balance
